definition: to visit shops to buy things
description: A laughing young woman in a pale yellow raincoat and jeans walks along the wet pavement of a rainy shopping street with shop fronts and white awnings. She holds a black umbrella and points at a shop window. She leads a small brown pony that carries paper shopping bags on both sides, one with a long baguette sticking out. A shop assistant in an apron stands in a doorway, and behind them a cyclist rides by and people hurry through the rain, one holding a box over his head.

en.question: What is the woman in yellow doing?

de.answer: Sie geht mit einem Pony einkaufen.
de.question: Was macht die Frau in Gelb?

es.answer: Está yendo de compras con un poni.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer de amarillo?

fr.answer: Elle fait du shopping avec un poney.
